jobs.title: Project Coordinator IV - Sustainability
jobs.description:
The Tsui Group is seeking a candidate who is qualified and experienced in educational facility construction projects to serve as a Project Coordinator IV – (Sustainability) for a large educational client within Los Angeles County.

**Position Overview:**

The Project Coordinator IV - Sustainability provides project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the BuildLACCD Sustainability Strike Team throughout the planning, scoping, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of sustainability and energy-related capital improvement projects across the Los Angeles Community College District (LACCD).

The Project Coordinator IV will work under the direction of the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, this position supports the Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers and coordinates with District personnel, Campus Administration, College Project Teams (CPTs), Program Management Office (PMO), Program Controls, and other Stakeholders to support project budget development, funding verification, cost forecasting, financial reporting, and project establishment.

The position supports Districtwide sustainability initiatives, including Energy Information Systems (EIS), Sustainability and Climate Action Roadmap, Building Management Systems (BMS), Central Plant and Local Building Decarbonization, Central Plant optimization, LED lighting upgrades, energy efficiency retrofits, renewable energy systems, Photovoltaic (PV), microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, electrification, and other sustainability-related capital improvement projects.

**Position Description:**

* Provide day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain project management documents, records, correspondence, reports, and other project-related communications.
* Support project establishment and White Paper development by coordinating financial documentation, funding verification, preliminary budgets, cost estimates, and required reviews in accordance with established BuildLACCD PMO Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Coordinate with District personnel, CPTs, PMO, Program Controls, and other stakeholders to verify project budgets, available funding, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial requirements.
* Coordinate with CPTs and PMO Cost Analysts to support budget establishment, monitoring, budget transfers, and accurate financial reporting.
* Develop and maintain cost forecasts and Estimates-to-Complete (ETCs); track Change Order Requests (CORs), commitments, and funding availability.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contract balances, remaining encumbrances, funding availability, and financial risks to identify potential shortfalls before they affect project delivery.
* Work with PMO Cost Analysts to verify the accuracy and integrity of project budgets and financial forecasts in accordance with established cost management procedures.
* Participate in change management and risk assessment meetings to identify cost-related trends, risks, exposures, and potential mitigation strategies.
* Perform monthly budget and cost reconciliations to support accurate month-end reporting and review expenditures across multiple funding sources.
* Coordinate with scheduling teams to assess cash flow and schedule performance impacts on costs, including variances, overruns, underruns, and forecasting concerns.
* Review financial reports, cost performance, and progress data; communicate material variances and potential financial risks to Project Managers and appropriate stakeholders.
* Track contract Periods of Performance (POP), contract balances, remaining encumbrances, and available funding.
* Coordinate invoice oversight and reconciliation with accounting and project stakeholders to support timely and accurate payment processing.
* Collaborate with PMO to validate project budget data, support stakeholder dashboards, and maintain accurate program controls databases and financial reports.
* Gather physical completion data and coordinate updates to project budget and forecast records as
* appropriate.
* Proactively identify funding issues that could delay procurement, contract execution, project initiation, or other critical activities.
* Support compliance with applicable District requirements, BuildLACCD PMO SOPs, cost management procedures, and bond funding requirements throughout project development and implementation.
* Perform other bond-eligible project cost management and coordination duties as directed by the Sustainability Strike Team Lead.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  
**Requirements**

**Minimum Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of five (5) years of recent professional experience in engineering, project management,
* sustainability, project controls, cost management, and/or a related field.
* BS/BA degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sustainability, or a related field. Four additional years of qualifying experience beyond the minimum experience requirement may be substituted for the required education.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial modeling, budget tracking, and reporting.

* Ability to work independently, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and manage multiple project priorities.

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator – Residential Remodeling
jobs.description:
Construction Project Coordinator – Residential Remodeling

**Company:** Kitchen by Design Inc.  
**Location:** Pasadena, CA  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site and Local Project Visits  
**Compensation:** $50,000–$60,000 annually, depending on experience  
**Experience:** 2–3 years preferred

About Kitchen by Design

Kitchen by Design is a family-owned general contracting and residential remodeling company based in Pasadena, California. We specialize in kitchen and bathroom remodeling, custom cabinetry, countertops, flooring, custom closets, and interior renovations.

As our company continues to grow, we are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Construction Project Coordinator to help manage our projects, support daily operations, and contribute to the continued growth of our business.

Position Overview

The Construction Project Coordinator will work closely with company ownership, subcontractors, vendors, and homeowners to ensure remodeling projects are properly scheduled, organized, and completed efficiently.

This is a hands-on position that combines project coordination, field visits, material procurement, customer communication, and operational support.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys solving problems, and is interested in developing a long-term career in residential construction and project management.

Key Responsibilities

**Project Coordination & Scheduling**

* Coordinate daily and weekly schedules for active remodeling projects.
* Communicate with subcontractors, installers, suppliers, and homeowners regarding upcoming work.
* Track project timelines, milestones, and outstanding tasks.
* Coordinate material deliveries and installation schedules.
* Identify scheduling conflicts and communicate potential delays.
* Assist management with maintaining organized and efficient project workflows.

**Customer Communication**

* Provide homeowners with regular project updates.
* Coordinate site visits, installation appointments, and project walkthroughs.
* Respond to routine customer questions and scheduling requests.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the remodeling process.
* Escalate significant concerns or project changes to management.

**Materials & Vendor Coordination**

* Track cabinetry, countertops, flooring, fixtures, hardware, and other project materials.
* Communicate with suppliers regarding pricing, lead times, availability, and deliveries.
* Assist with obtaining material quotes and coordinating purchase orders.
* Monitor deliveries and help resolve missing, damaged, or delayed materials.

**Field Visits & Measurements**

* Visit active job sites to document progress and identify outstanding items.
* Assist with field measurements for kitchens, bathrooms, cabinetry, countertops, closets, and other remodeling projects.
* Learn and follow the company's standardized measurement procedures.
* Prepare measurement notes, sketches, photographs, and site documentation.
* After appropriate training, perform routine site surveys and measurements independently, subject to required verification procedures.

**Project Documentation & JobTread**

* Maintain accurate project schedules, notes, tasks, and documentation in JobTread.
* Organize project photos, subcontractor information, material selections, and customer communications.
* Assist with tracking change-order requests and project expenses.
* Coordinate punch lists, warranty requests, and project closeout documentation.
* Help improve project templates, checklists, and internal workflows.

Operational Development & Additional Responsibilities

In addition to coordinating active remodeling projects, this position will support operational improvements and business development initiatives, particularly during periods of lower construction activity.

Responsibilities may include researching and developing relationships with new suppliers and vendors, identifying and screening qualified subcontractors, obtaining competitive material and labor pricing, assisting with estimating and proposal preparation, organizing showroom samples and product information, and conducting introductory outreach to local contractors, designers, and other potential trade partners.

The coordinator may also assist with documenting completed projects through photography and video, maintaining vendor and subcontractor databases, preparing upcoming projects, and improving internal processes.

These responsibilities are intended to help strengthen company operations, expand our professional network, and support long-term growth throughout the year.

Qualifications

* 2–3 years of experience in construction coordination, project administration, residential remodeling, or a related field preferred.
* Familiarity with residential construction processes, materials, and subcontractor scheduling.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable communicating directly with homeowners, vendors, and subcontractors.
* Proficiency with computers, email, spreadsheets, and project management software.
* Experience with JobTread or similar construction management software is a plus.
* **Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.**
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to local project sites.
* Willingness to learn field measurements, estimating procedures, and other construction operations.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate should be able to coordinate routine project schedules, maintain accurate project documentation, communicate effectively with subcontractors and customers, assist with site surveys, and independently handle assigned operational responsibilities.

As the employee develops, they will have opportunities to assume greater responsibility for project execution, vendor coordination, and operational improvements.

jobs.title: Ride Home Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Organization**

The Anti-Recidivism Coalition (ARC) works to end mass incarceration in California. To ensure our

communities are safe, healthy, and whole, ARC empowers formerly and currently incarcerated people to

thrive by providing a support network, comprehensive reentry services, and opportunities to advocate for

policy change. Through our grassroots policy advocacy, we are dedicated to transforming the criminal

justice system so that it is more just and equitable for all people. Learn more at: www.antirecidivism.org.

**Position Summary**

The Ride Home Program (RHP) Coordinator plays a pivotal role in the daily management and

administration of the Ride Home Program at the Anti-Recidivism Coalition. This position operates within

the ARC's member peer network, focusing on providing immediate reentry support to individuals

returning home from incarceration. The RHP Coordinator is responsible for facilitating rides home from

prison, ensuring a warm and supportive welcome upon release, and equipping participants with the

tools and resources necessary for a successful reintegration into society. This position also manages

transportation services for incoming residents of ARC's housing program.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Collaborate with institutions, counselors, and Probation Officers (PO) to assign and oversee the pick-up of recently released individuals through the Ride Home Program.
* Specific responsibilities include arranging accommodations and coordinating travel and transportation for individuals who have been newly released.
* In addition to assigning Ride Home drivers to pick-ups, provide local rides within scheduled shifts.
* Conduct thorough follow-up with recently released individuals who are participating in the Ride Home Program.
* Provide mentorship through regular communication and consultations.
* Facilitate connections to local reentry resources and support programs.
* Develop and maintain a tracking mechanism to demonstrate the Ride Home Program’s impact on reducing recidivism rates.
* Oversee the internal administration of the Ride Home Program at ARC. This includes processing travel reimbursements, monitoring Ride Home Program revenue and expenses, and developing and tracking program budgets.
* Collaborate with the Development department to actively contribute to the funding of the Ride Home Program.
* Support the follow-up with potential eligible members whose entry point was the Ride Home Program.

• As a valued member of the Member Services team, the RHP Coordinator may be called upon to assist the department in various additional tasks and initiatives.• Document Program participant application review and process them into case management system.

* Communicate with each participant Via institutional tablet or phone and verify all information provided.
* Schedule Monthly trainings for RHP Drivers.
* Assess RHP recipient reentry needs: Resources, housing, employment and or other support.
* Research, vet, and track resources for Members, including housing, Jobs, personal development, Drug treatment and education.
* Assist with reviewing and processing reimbursement forms from RHP Drivers including, log receipts, summary of drive, mileage, and photos.
* Work with our Communications Department to implement new ways to promote the RHP.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of one year of experience in case management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Knowledge of social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram.
* Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
* Ability to multitask effectively, or a willingness to learn and adapt to multitasking requirements.
* Possesses leadership characteristics and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Has a reliable vehicle and a valid driver's license.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as necessary.

**Salary/Benefits**

* Pay rate is $31.00 - $35.25 D.O.E.
* Medical, dental, vision benefits
* Employer-funded life insurance
* Paid vacation and sick leave

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

***Anti-Recidivism Coalition is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider employment qualified***

***applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Fair Chance***

***Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.***

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

The Program Coordinator supports the Volunteer Center's headquarters in Torrance, working closely with staff, volunteers, schools, businesses, and community partners to implement programs that make a meaningful difference in the lives of local children and families.

This position plays an important role in bringing the Volunteer Center's mission to life through the coordination of community programs, volunteer activities, and partnerships. With a primary focus on **Food For Kids, Operation Teddy Bear, and corporate and group volunteer activations**, the Program Coordinator helps connect people and resources to community needs while ensuring programs operate smoothly and effectively.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, personable, and passionate about community service. This hands-on, collaborative role offers opportunities to build relationships, lead meaningful volunteer experiences, and contribute directly to the well-being of the communities we serve.

**Key ResponsibilitiesProgram Coordination & Operations**

* Coordinate and support the implementation of the Volunteer Center's community programs, primarily Food For Kids and Operation Teddy Bear, ensuring activities align with organizational goals and community needs.
* Oversee day-to-day program operations, including resource management, inventory, logistics, and preparation for ongoing and seasonal activities.
* Plan and coordinate program activities, distributions, and special projects to ensure successful execution and timely completion.
* Collaborate with staff, volunteers, schools, and community partners to support program delivery and create meaningful experiences for participants.
* Build and maintain relationships with community partners, donors, and participating organizations to strengthen program reach and effectiveness.
* Monitor program needs, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure activities meet established guidelines, reporting requirements, and deadlines.
* Identify opportunities to improve program efficiency, strengthen volunteer engagement, and expand the Volunteer Center's impact in the community.

**Corporate and Group Volunteer Activations**

* Plan and lead volunteer activities for corporate partners, schools, and community organizations.
* Respond promptly to group inquiries, identify appropriate opportunities, and coordinate participation.
* Manage event logistics, including scheduling, supplies, space preparation, instructions, and setup.
* Welcome groups and share engaging presentations about the Volunteer Center's mission, programs, and community impact.
* Provide hands-on leadership to ensure activities are organized, meaningful, and productive.
* Build relationships with corporate and community partners to encourage continued involvement.
* Collaborate with the Volunteer Coordinator and staff to identify volunteer needs and develop opportunities.
* Track volunteer participation, hours, and outcomes; assist with follow-up communications.

**Program Administration and Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of program activities, distributions, donations, inventory, volunteers, and outcomes.
* Complete assigned sections of the Monthly Program Report accurately and on time.
* Collect data for grant reports, annual reports, audits, and program evaluations.
* Maintain organized program files, calendars, contact lists, and procedures.
* Monitor expenditures, inventory needs, and deadlines with the Director of Programs.
* Identify challenges, recommend solutions, and support program improvements.

**Community Engagement and Partnerships**

* Represent the Volunteer Center professionally with volunteers, donors, schools, businesses, and community partners.
* Respond to program inquiries promptly and professionally.
* Develop and maintain relationships with community partners to support program needs.
* Conduct program tours, orientations, and presentations for volunteers, donors, and community groups.
* Collaborate with staff to connect individuals and groups with appropriate volunteer opportunities.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Experience in program coordination, nonprofit operations, volunteer management, community engagement, event planning, logistics, or a related field.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to independently manage projects and deadlines.
* Excellent communication, customer service, and relationship-building skills.
* Demonstrated initiative, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
* Ability to lead and work effectively with volunteers, partners, and staff.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and office software.
* Ability to maintain accurate records, track data, and complete reports.

jobs.description:
**About Us**

The Office of the Los Angeles City Attorney is one of the nation's largest municipal law offices. With over 1,000 legal professionals, including 500 attorneys, the Office provides the City of Los Angeles (“City”) with the highest caliber of legal services, ranging from prosecuting criminal misdemeanors and playing a leading role in criminal justice reform to advising on homelessness initiatives, defending civil lawsuits and claims, and bringing civil enforcement actions in the name of the People of the State of California.

Guided by an overarching commitment to integrity, service and accountability, we find great meaning in the work we do and the services we provide.

We seek collaborative team players who understand that fulfilling our mission is key to making a positive impact.

**Description**
---------------

The Criminal Branch is responsible for the processing of misdemeanor cases filed throughout the City of Los Angeles. The Criminal Branch is seeking a dedicated, detail-oriented professional to support efforts to strengthen enforcement of Domestic Violence Restraining Orders (DVROs), with a specific focus on firearm relinquishment compliance. In addition to project-specific responsibilities, this position will perform administrative coordination duties, including data collection, report preparation, policy and procedure support, and internal operational improvements. The coordinator plays a key role in victim safety, systems coordination, public awareness, and ensuring efficient office and program administration.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

Under the direction and supervision of the Program Manager, the Administrative Coordinator I will act as Project Coordinator and will, for the term of the grant:

* Support interagency coordination between law enforcement, the City Attorney’s Office, Family Court, and DV service providers to ensure timely firearm relinquishment in DVRO cases.
* Track noncompliance findings, support law enforcement investigations, and facilitate legal follow-up.
* Collect data, prepare reports and correspondence, and conduct analyses related to DVRO enforcement, program activities, and administrative operations.
* Review DVRO noncompliance reports referred by the City Attorney’s Office and notify appropriate supervisors or case filers.
* Identify cases involving defendants with open criminal matters and coordinate follow-up.
* Collaborate with law enforcement to monitor firearm relinquishment progress and document outcomes.
* Provide referrals to the Victim Assistance Program (VAP) for impacted survivors.
* Assist with follow-up tasks, such as locating firearms, updating contact information for petitioners, and navigating proof of service requirements.
* Support a pilot project tracking DVRO filings at Stanley Mosk Courthouse, identifying cases involving firearms or ammunition for further legal/advocacy action.
* Flag cases lacking proof of compliance for continued monitoring.
* Contribute to the design and rollout of an outreach campaign focused on DVRO rights, resources, and firearm safety.
* Assist in planning stakeholder trainings, community presentations, and other public education events.
* Participate in monthly DVRO Enforcement Task Force and stakeholder meetings to share updates and discuss case-level challenges.
* The duties are subject to change based on operational needs during or following the term of grant.

**Requirements**
----------------

At least one year of full-time professional experience performing duties and responsibilities related to the Administrative Coordinator I position. Additional requirements include:

* Experience working in domestic violence advocacy, legal services, or systems coordination required.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with multidisciplinary partners, including attorneys, law enforcement, and community organizations.
* Knowledge of DVRO processes, firearm relinquishment laws, and trauma-informed, victim-centered practices is highly desirable.
* Excellent organizational skills, writing ability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
* Proficiency in the operation of personal computers, including maintaining databases and spreadsheets. Applicants must be proficient in MS Excel, including analysis of data in Excel.
* Initiative, ability to exercise independent judgment, and works well under pressure and deadlines with minimal amount of supervision.
* Ability to work closely with the public and external agencies.

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
Invisible Narratives, the first-of-its-kind tra-digital studio, is looking for a Community Manager to help scale a fast-growing slate of creator-led IP. This is a hands-on, front-facing role embedded in the heart of fandoms, creator networks, and YouTube ecosystems — with an equal focus on engagement, creator support, and operational oversight.

**Who We’re Looking For**

You’re part community lead, part YouTube strategist, part brand steward. You’ve worked at an indie game studio, animation collective, or startup where creators, fans, and channels were part of a single living ecosystem. You’re comfortable being a visible voice for the brand — hosting AMAs, answering lore questions, and managing creator relationships — but you also know how to use the backend: CMS, metadata, analytics, and compliance workflows.

You’ll work across fan communities, creator networks, and YouTube channels — helping grow engagement, enforce best practices, and translate insights into action. This isn’t a community job in name only — you’ll be at the center of how our IP lives, evolves, and scales.

**What You’ll Do**

* Actively engage across Discord, YouTube, X, Reddit, and other community platforms
* Be a visible, trusted voice in the community — leading AMAs, town halls, and fan-facing updates
* Manage relationships with our alliance network of creators — from indie animators to UGC developers
* Collaborate with the marketing and content teams on YouTube rollouts and go-to-market strategies
* Manage YouTube CMS tasks, including metadata updates, channel structure, playlisting, and end-screen/post optimization
* Monitor compliance and brand alignment across partner channels — ensuring creators follow usage guidelines, brand safety requirements, and content obligations
* Track and report analytics from both fan communities and YouTube channels, surfacing trends, feedback, and red flags
* Coordinate with external agencies and internal teams to align messaging and strategy
* Contribute to content planning, surprise community drops, and fan-facing events

**What You Need**

* 2–4 years experience in community management, YouTube operations, or digital marketing
* Strong working knowledge of YouTube CMS, channel structure, metadata optimization, and platform policies
* Experience working with creator networks or digital IP (animation, gaming, or UGC platforms preferred)
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to manage both fan expectations and creator relationships
* Familiarity with Discord, Reddit, and social ecosystems where fan and creator communities thrive
* Excellent written communication and real-time engagement instincts
* Proficiency in basic analytics/reporting tools (YouTube Studio, Discord admin, or social dashboards)
* Bonus: light design or motion skills for community content or channel assets

You’ll be the connective tissue between the studio, creators, and fans — helping us build something bigger than just a show or a game. If you’ve lived in the trenches of internet fandoms and creator platforms, we want you in ours.

jobs.title: Warehouse & Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Build Your Career Where You Matter
  
Join CBX Solutions, the nation’s leading provider of architectural doors, frames, hardware, specialty products, and complete security integration services.
  
At CBX Solutions, trust and communication are the foundation of how we work. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture where your voice is heard, your ideas matter, and your career has room to grow. Whether you're a problem-solver, innovator, or passionate about service, you’ll thrive here. Be part of a team that invests in your future, celebrates your success, and values your contribution.
  
  
Why Work With Us?
  
We’re committed to your success, personally and professionally. You’ll have access to:
  

* Comprehensive Benefits: Health, dental, vision, prescription coverage, life insurance, and 401(k) with company match.
* Work-Life Balance: Generous paid time off for rest, family, and self-care.
* Career Growth: You’ll benefit from continuous learning, mentorship, and leadership training including access to CBX University, our in-house development program.
* Supportive Culture: Innovation, creativity, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do.

The Warehouse & Purchasing Coordinator is responsible for end-to-end warehouse operations, including receiving, shipping, inventory control, fleet coordination, and maintaining a safe, efficient facility. This role also manages procurement and RMA processes, ensuring timely and cost-effective sourcing of materials and equipment to support business needs. The ideal candidate has proven experience in warehouse and purchasing operations, with strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to drive improvements independently.​
  
  
Essential Functions
  

* Perform and coordinate daily warehouse activities, including receiving, inventory handling, material staging, and outbound distribution to support project and service operations.
* Maintain a clean, organized facility while ensuring consistent application of safety standards and regulatory compliance
* Track inventory movement and accuracy, performing physical counts, and reconciling discrepancies with system data
* Handle fleet coordination, including routine maintenance scheduling and vehicle utilization.
* Collaborate with operations and back-office teams to evaluate vendors and procure materials, equipment, and vehicles.
* Execute purchasing decisions in collaboration with other departments for stock and project-specific items, guiding inventory additions/deletions based on business needs.
* Manage the return goods (RMA) process, ensuring timely resolution, minimized return costs, and proper vendor credit.
* Address warehouse issues or incidents directly, documenting root causes and implementing corrective actions.
* Occasionally deliver or transport materials and equipment to job sites when needed.
* Conduct scheduled physical inventories to ensure accurate reconciliation to maintain inventory integrity.
* Promote and maintain high safety standards across warehouse and logistics operations.
* Provide light facilities support as needed to maintain a safe and functional workplace.
* Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by the management team.

Minimum Qualifications
  

* High School Diploma or GED required
* Minimum 3 years of warehouse management experience
* Knowledge of physical security systems, network devices
* Experience in purchasing and procurement of warehouse-related materials is a plus
* Ability to lift over 50 pounds and work comfortably on ladders and lifts
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong focus on delivering exceptional service
* Proficient with basic hand and power tools, and knowledgeable in electrical circuitry and blueprint reading
* Current and valid US driver’s license

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  

* ​​Self-motivated; able to work with minimal supervision
* ​Strong computer skills including Microsoft Office products
* ​Ability to think independently
* ​Good communication skills, written and verbal​

Walking and talking or hearing are required for approximately one-third of the working day. This role requires frequent lifting of items weighing 25–50 pounds and occasional lifting of items exceeding 50 pounds. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.
  
Work Environment
  
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: Law Library Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Law Library Director, the Law Library Operations Coordinator supports the day-to-day business operations of the Darling Law Library, ensuring its financial, administrative, and procedural functions run efficiently and reliably. The Coordinator oversees library expenditures, accounting, and financial tracking and reporting, ensuring compliance with applicable policies and procedures. The position develops and maintains operational and procedural documentation, coordinates logistical support for law library programs and activities, and provides operations support to the Director and library departments. The Coordinator also supports acquisitions and collection maintenance.

Responsibilities

**Operations Support to Director & Law Library Departments**

* Support process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and productivity.
* Prepare statistical and financial reports for the Law Library Director.
* Maintain the library’s annual calendar.
* Retrieve, sort, and distribute library mail.
* Provide circulation coverage as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Financial and Account Support**

* Manage processing and payment of law library invoices.
* Monitor and reconcile library funds and purchase orders in PeopleSoft.
* Assign fund codes, obtain payment authorizations, and send invoice to Accounts Payable.
* Coordinate with counterparts in the School of Law and University Departments.Maintain library invoice and financial records.
* Prepare regular reports and analysis on the library’s collections and operations budgets.
* Manage fiscal year-end accounting procedures.
* Conduct fiscal year closing and opening.
* Assist with University systems (Concur, Canvas).
* Update and maintain financial and account management documentation.

**Acquisitions and Collections Support**

* Monitor expenditures for monographs and other acquisitions, including coordination with university financial services, as needed.
* Monitor acquisitions of gifts-in-kind in consultation with the Law Library Director or designate.
* Serve as primary liaison on acquisitions and accounting issues
* Resolve payment problems and discrepancies.
* Solve complex acquisitions and account issues.
* Serve as backup to routine acquisitions and financial processing tasks.
* Update and maintain documentation.
  

  

Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint).
* Proven ability to track expenditures through activity reports.
* Strong service orientation and problem-solving skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills to work with diverse groups at all organizational levels, both inside and outside the University.
* Demonstrated writing skills and strong attention to detail; ability to produce clear, concise, accurate documentation.
* Ability to independently prioritize tasks when faced with interruptions and fluctuating workload.
* Ability to use tact and diplomacy.
* Exceptional attention to detail and analytical skills.
* Proven track record of maintaining confidentiality when working with sensitive or restricted information.

Desired Qualifications

* Experience with systems such as Concur and Canva.
* Experience in a library public services or technical services department, preferably academic.
* Experience with financial systems (preferably PeopleSoft).
* Experience in accurately processing invoices and tracking budget activities, preferably in an academic library.
* Proficiency with financial or enterprise systems such as PeopleSoft.
* Familiarity with integrated library systems (e.g., FOLIO or Sierra).

Special Instructions to Applicants

At Chapman University, we believe collaboration thrives through in-person engagement. This position is fully on campus, and employees work alongside colleagues, faculty, students, and staff each day to support our vibrant university community.

Chapman University is an equal opportunity employer that provides equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of their protected characteristics. All qualified applicants and employees are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by state or federal law.

Applicants for Staff and Administrator positions must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

The offer of employment is contingent upon satisfactory completion and outcomes of a criminal background screening and returning to the Office of Human Resources a signed original acceptance of the Chapman University Agreement to Arbitrate.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager – Residential Remodeling
jobs.description:
Assistant Project Manager – Residential Remodeling

**Company:** Kitchen by Design Inc.  
**Location:** Pasadena, CA  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site and Local Project Visits  
**Compensation:** $60,000–$75,000 annually, depending on experience  
**Experience:** 3–5+ years preferred

About Kitchen by Design

Kitchen by Design is a family-owned general contracting and residential remodeling company based in Pasadena, California. We specialize in kitchen and bathroom remodeling, custom cabinetry, countertops, flooring, custom closets, and interior renovations.

As our business continues to grow, we are seeking an experienced, motivated, and highly organized Assistant Project Manager who can take ownership of daily project operations, coordinate multiple remodeling projects, and help improve the efficiency of our business.

Position Overview

The Assistant Project Manager will play a key role in overseeing the day-to-day execution of residential remodeling projects, working directly with company ownership, subcontractors, suppliers, and homeowners.

We are looking for someone who can independently manage schedules, coordinate trades, communicate with customers, identify potential problems, and keep projects moving forward without constant supervision.

This position also offers opportunities to contribute to supplier development, subcontractor recruitment, estimating, field measurements, operational improvements, and business growth initiatives.

The ideal candidate is proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking responsibility in a fast-paced, growing construction company.

Key Responsibilities

**Project Management & Scheduling**

* Coordinate the daily execution of multiple residential remodeling projects.
* Develop, maintain, and update project schedules and timelines.
* Manage subcontractor sequencing and coordinate multiple construction trades.
* Monitor project milestones, deadlines, and material readiness.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts and proactively develop solutions.
* Conduct regular project site visits to monitor progress.
* Keep management informed of project status, risks, and outstanding decisions.

**Subcontractor & Vendor Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for routine subcontractor coordination.
* Schedule and coordinate cabinetry installation, countertops, flooring, plumbing, electrical, tile, painting, and other construction trades.
* Confirm subcontractor availability and coordinate upcoming work.
* Identify and help resolve routine field coordination issues.
* Monitor subcontractor performance and communicate quality or scheduling concerns.
* Assist with obtaining competitive subcontractor bids and material pricing.

**Customer Communication**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned remodeling projects.
* Provide homeowners with consistent project updates.
* Manage customer expectations regarding schedules, deliveries, and construction progress.
* Address routine customer concerns professionally and proactively.
* Coordinate walkthroughs, inspections, and project completion activities.
* Escalate significant contractual, technical, or financial decisions to company ownership.

**Field Measurements & Site Surveys**

* Conduct site visits to evaluate existing project conditions.
* Learn and follow the company's standardized measurement and site documentation procedures.
* Perform field measurements for kitchens, bathrooms, cabinetry, countertops, closets, and other remodeling projects after appropriate training.
* Prepare detailed measurement sketches, photographs, and site condition reports.
* Identify potential installation conflicts, appliance clearance issues, and other field conditions.
* Coordinate final measurement verification and approvals before custom fabrication or material ordering.

**Materials, Purchasing & Budget Coordination**

* Coordinate material procurement, deliveries, and installation readiness.
* Communicate with vendors regarding product availability, pricing, and lead times.
* Track material orders and identify potential delays.
* Assist with preparing project budgets, cost estimates, and subcontractor bid comparisons.
* Monitor project expenses and identify potential cost overruns.
* Document change-order requests and coordinate approvals before additional work proceeds.
* Assist management in improving purchasing efficiency and project profitability.

**Quality Control & Project Closeout**

* Conduct regular site walkthroughs to review workmanship and project progress.
* Identify incomplete or deficient work and coordinate necessary corrections.
* Maintain project punch lists and follow through on outstanding items.
* Coordinate warranty-related service requests.
* Assist with final inspections and customer walkthroughs.
* Ensure project documentation is complete before closeout.

**JobTread & Operational Management**

* Maintain accurate project schedules, tasks, notes, budgets, and progress updates in JobTread.
* Track outstanding action items across multiple projects.
* Maintain organized project records, photos, subcontractor information, and customer communications.
* Prepare regular project status updates for company ownership.
* Identify opportunities to improve project templates, workflows, scheduling procedures, and internal reporting.

Operational Development & Additional Responsibilities

In addition to managing active construction projects, the Assistant Project Manager will contribute to strengthening and expanding company operations, particularly during periods of lower project activity.

Responsibilities may include identifying, evaluating, and developing relationships with new subcontractors, suppliers, manufacturers, and vendors; obtaining and comparing competitive bids; assisting with supplier pricing discussions; and helping establish a reliable network of qualified trade professionals.

jobs.description:
Earthjustice is the nation's leading environmental law organization. We wield the power of law and the strength of partnership to protect people’s health, preserve magnificent places and wildlife, advance clean energy, and combat climate change. *We are here because the Earth needs a good lawyer.*

Driven by a passion for justice, inclusion, partnership, and excellence, our core values lead us to seek a broad range of perspectives and backgrounds to achieve our mission and maintain an inclusive environment where all staff are valued and respected.

The Executive Assistant provides executive administrative support to Development executives by managing schedules, facilitating workflow, supporting projects, meeting and event planning and coordination, and other critical administrative duties. This position anticipates information needs, proactively coordinates information flow, and contributes to the creation of effective systems. The Executive Assistant works independently with minimal direction and is adept progressing action through ambiguity; is exceptionally responsive, action-oriented, and possesses a keen eye for detail and context; handles confidential matters with sound judgment and utmost discretion; is able to quickly pivot, re-prioritize, and flex between supporting and complementing different working styles; and is an enthusiastic team player able to identify gaps and problem solve.

Reporting to the Director, Development Leadership Team (DLT), this position works a full-time schedule (37.5 hours/week). Preference will be given to candidates willing to work at least one day per week from our San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Los Angeles, CA, Chicago, IL, or Denver, CO office, but remote candidates in the contiguous U.S. who are willing to travel periodically will also be considered.

This is a non-supervisory position.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Executive Administration and Support (70%)**

* Serve as primary scheduler and calendar manager for Development executives and Director, DLT, coordinating with stakeholders to ensure time is allocated in accordance with strategic priorities.
* Provide administrative and logistical support, including expense filing, travel coordination, document management, and task tracking.
* Manage fundraising strategy processes and trainings, track opportunities, and prioritize across departmental requests in partnership with Director, DLT and the Office of the President.

**Meeting & Logistical Planning, Coordination, and Project Support (30%)**

* Provide Development project, initiative, and communications coordination, planning, and execution.
* Plan, organize, and execute logistics for development staff outings, trainings, retreats, and group activities, including planning for the annual department-wide travel meeting.

* Ability to prioritize and multitask with strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills in a fast-paced, high-volume role.
* Outstanding interpersonal, organizational, and verbal/written communication skills.

* Adaptability, resilience, curiosity, and openness to feedback.
* Available for business travel 5 or more days per year as required for in-person planning meetings.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator**

Full-Time | Non-Exempt

**Salary:** $60,000 - $70,000 Annually

**Location:** Irvine, CA

**Department:** Project Management

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Role Overview**

The Project Coordinator keeps MVE + Partners project teams organized and clients informed. This role runs the administrative backbone of our multifamily residential and mixed-use projects — preparing meeting agendas, taking and distributing minutes, tracking action items, and coordinating communication between our architects, clients, consultants, and contractors. The ideal candidate is highly organized, writes clearly, and is comfortable in fast-moving meetings where design and technical decisions get made. This is a strong entry point for someone interested in architecture, design, or construction project management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Meeting Management & Documentation**

* Prepare and distribute agendas for client, consultant, OAC (owner-architect-contractor), and internal design meetings
* Attend meetings in person and virtually; take accurate, concise minutes that capture decisions, open items, owners, and due dates
* Distribute minutes within 48 hours and maintain a running action-item log through project close
* Schedule meetings, book rooms, and manage calendars and invites for project teams

**Client & Team Coordination**

* Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for client and consultant communications, routing technical questions to the right team member
* Track deliverable deadlines and remind teams of upcoming milestones and submissions
* Coordinate document exchanges with clients, structural/MEP/civil/landscape consultants, and general contractors
* Support client presentations by assembling materials, printing sets, and managing logistics; occasional travel to client offices and project sites in Southern California

**Project Administration & Document Control**

* Maintain project files, contact lists, and directories in Egnyte according to firm standards
* Prepare transmittals and track RFIs, submittals, and permit or plan-check status in project logs
* Track agency submissions and plan-check comments with the project team
* Support the Project Manager with contracts, proposals, change-order and additional-services documentation

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in architecture, construction management, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 1-3 years of experience in project coordination, administrative support, or office operations, preferably at an architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate firm
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams
* Excellent written communication, with the ability to turn a fast-moving discussion into clear, accurate minutes
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through across multiple projects and deadlines
* Professional, confident communication with clients, consultants, and senior staff, and discretion with confidential project information

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with architectural project phases and terminology
* Exposure to multifamily residential, mixed-use, or residential development
* Experience with RFI, submittal, and document-control workflows
* Working knowledge of Bluebeam, Adobe Acrobat, or Autodesk; experience with AI note-taking tools is a plus

**What This Role Offers**

* A central role on project teams with direct exposure to clients, consultants, and the full architectural design and delivery process
* Close collaboration with project managers and principals at a firm with roughly 50 years of multifamily and mixed-use experience
* A foundation for growth into project management or studio operations roles
* Hybrid flexibility per firm policy

*MVE + Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**Description**

**Who We Are:** Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something. Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly. Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Part-Time; 12 hours/week; Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday - 10am - 2pm

 **Requirements**

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 5 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

  
**Benefits**

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages: $22/hr based on experience level
* 401k Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Long-term opportunities for advancement within Fooda
* Networking opportunities for work or career with local restaurants
* A fulfilling, challenging work experience and free food!

Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No phone calls or recruiters please.

* We believe in making a difference every day.
* We offer performance- based bonuses.

**Position Summary**

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) serves as the primary post-sales relationship owner for a portfolio of 10-20 strategic enterprise accounts. This role is responsible for driving customer satisfaction, product adoption, retention, and long-term account growth while acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers.

The ideal candidate combines strong customer relationship management skills with technical expertise, enabling them to effectively engage with IT leaders, technical stakeholders, system administrators, and business decision-makers. The CSM will proactively identify risks, drive issue resolution, coordinate cross-functional resources, and ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes from their technology investments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Manage a portfolio of 10-20 strategic enterprise accounts.
* Establish and maintain trusted advisor relationships with customer executives, IT leadership, and operational stakeholders.
* Conduct regular business reviews to assess customer satisfaction, usage trends, success metrics, and strategic objectives.
* Develop account success plans aligned with customer business goals.
* Advocate for customer needs internally and provide the voice of the customer to product, engineering, support, and sales teams.

**Technical Customer Success**

* Serve as a technical point of contact for customer deployments, integrations, upgrades, and operational issues.
* Understand customer environments, workflows, infrastructure, and use cases.
* Provide guidance on best practices for solution adoption and optimization.
* Coordinate technical resources to address escalations, performance concerns, and deployment challenges.
* Translate complex technical concepts into business value for executive stakeholders.

**Customer Adoption & Retention**

* Drive successful onboarding and implementation activities.
* Develop adoption plans to maximize utilization of products, services, and support programs.
* Monitor customer health indicators and proactively address risks.
* Identify potential churn indicators and create mitigation strategies.
* Ensure achievement of customer success milestones and contractual obligations.

**Issue & Escalation Management**

* Lead cross-functional resolution efforts for customer issues.
* Coordinate activities across support, engineering, product management, service delivery, and sales teams.
* Provide timely communication during critical customer escalations.
* Track and report issue status through resolution.
* Ensure customer expectations are managed appropriately throughout the support lifecycle.

**Strategic Business Reviews**

* Prepare and present Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Executive Business Reviews (EBRs).
* Review operational performance, service metrics, adoption trends, and strategic initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for operational improvement and expanded value realization.
* Present recommendations to customer leadership teams.

**Revenue Expansion Support**

* Partner with Sales, Account Managers, and Solution Engineers to identify expansion opportunities.
* Support renewal activities through demonstration of value and customer outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for additional solutions, services, training, and support offerings.
* Provide subject matter expertise during customer planning discussions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or related customer-facing technology roles.
* Experience managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT environments and technology deployments.
* Experience working with hardware, software, SaaS, cloud, networking, mobility, rugged computing, or enterprise technology solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting public sector, enterprise, federal, healthcare, utility, manufacturing, transportation, or public safety customers.
* Understanding of enterprise device management, mobility solutions, operating systems, networking, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
* Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Dynamics 365, or similar systems.
* Technical certifications (CompTIA, Microsoft, Cisco, VMware, AWS, Azure, ITIL, etc.).
* Experience delivering executive-level business reviews.

jobs.description:
### **Position Summary:**

The Program Coordinator supports the San Francisco Immigrant Legal and Education Network (SFILEN) and the San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN) by coordinating partners on grant and contract administration, meetings, and network-wide programming. The Program Coordinator occasionally fills shifts on the SFRRN Hotline, coordinates logistics and develops content and materials for reports, events, campaigns, and social media.

### 

### **About Chinese for Affirmative Action (CAA)**

CAA was founded in 1969 to protect the civil and political rights of Chinese Americans and to advance multiracial democracy in the United States. Today, CAA is a progressive voice in and on behalf of the broader Asian American and Pacific Islander community. CAA advocates for systemic change that protects immigrant rights, promotes language diversity, and remedies racial and social injustice.

### 

### **About SFILEN and SFFRN**

The San Francisco Immigrant Legal and Education Network (SFILEN) and the San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN), are two leading immigration legal service networks in the City. Since their founding in 2006 and 2008 respectively, both networks have paved the way as successful models for multi-ethnic, multi-lingual, multi-strategy coalition building to advance immigrant rights and immigrant access to legal services.

  

The San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN) is a 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, immigration enforcement response hotline serving the City of San Francisco. Founded in 2008, and revamped in 2016, SFRRN was one of the first, and remains one of the few 24/7 immigration enforcement response hotlines in the country. SFRRN houses 8 immigration focused community based organizations who staff the 24/7 hotline, verifies immigration enforcement activity in San Francisco, connects San Franciscans to legal and accompaniment services, and provides immigration centered Know-Your-Rights to immigrant community members citywide.

  

In 2026, CAA became the lead and fiscal agency to house SFILEN and SFRRN. As a founding and active member of these networks, CAA is committed to the health and wellbeing of both collaboratives in order that partners may continue to serve immigrant communities with immigration legal services and community education in the face of heightened immigration enforcement and rising xenophobia.

  

### **Position Description**

Program Coordinator coordinates partners in both SFRRN and SFILEN in relation to administration of grants and contracts and network wide programing including regularly scheduled meetings, special events, and campaigns. The Program Coordinator also coordinates logistics, and develops content and materials to support the advancement of SFILEN and SFRRN including for reports, events, campaigns, and meetings. The Coordinator works to ensure alignment and accessibility of information for all network partners and relevant stakeholders. The Program Coordinator will also assist the SFRRN Manager in supporting hotline services including receiving hotline calls, conducting follow-up, and coordinating with partners to respond to incidents of immigration enforcement.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Administrative Support for SFRRN & SFILEN Grants and Contracts*

* Communicate regularly with partners in Spanish and English about administrative requirements, reporting, and deadlines associated with funder compliance.
* Support grant and contract management through monthly data entry, compilation of partner reports, and tracking of services rendered by partners.
* Work closely with the SFILEN and SFRRN Program Managers and the AACRE Capacity Team to ensure timely reporting, invoicing, and submission of funder-required documents across all funding sources.
* Take notes at SFILEN and SFRRN meetings, conduct post-meeting follow-up, and share out notes.
* Document trends from meetings and partner reports, and identify opportunities for systems improvement.
* Transcribe all Rapid Response Hotline calls, tracking and documenting trends and identifying opportunities for systems improvement. (SFRRN)

*Programmatic Coordination of SFILEN and SFRRN*

* Support program logistics and communications for both Networks, including email reminders and coordination of monthly calls, and meetings.
* Support logistics, coordination, and planning for annual programming. This includes Immigrant Family Day, International Migrants Day, budget advocacy, retreats, trainings, and other Network-wide events and activities.

*Content and Material Development*

* Create visuals, infographics, and digital media for SFILEN and SFRRN events, campaigns, programming, and meetings. Examples include fliers, one-pagers, advocacy and fundraising materials, toolkits, and communications content.

  

*Data and Research*

* Provide timely data from SFILEN and SFRRN’s work to respective Network staff, partners, and funders, and articulate and document analyses and impact of such data.
* Assist with the collection, and coordination of data retrieved from other related immigration networks, such as the California Coalition for Immigrant Justice (CCIJ), the San Francisco Immigrant Legal Defense Collaborative (SFILDC), and other partners including intakes, statistics, reports, and referrals to inform SFILEN and SFRRN’s work.
* Conduct and/or coordinate research projects on immigration trends, immigration policy changes, relevant community resources, and other subjects.

*Rapid Response Network*

* Serve as a dispatcher on the Rapid Response Hotline, where back-up is needed. This includes answering hotline phone calls, triaging emergency immigration situations, completing intake forms, and communicating with various stakeholders to coordinate service referrals.

**About Rocket Youth**

Rocket Youth owns and operates a growing portfolio of youth sports, enrichment, and after-school businesses across the United States. Our platform is intentionally multi-brand and multi-location, with each business maintaining its unique identity and local market focus.

We are highly acquisitive, completing approximately 10–15 acquisitions per year. Most of our companies are founder-led, with experienced local operators managing day-to-day operations.

Rocket Youth provides operational leadership and support services to improve performance and scale. These services span marketing, CRM, analytics, M&A/de-novo expansion, accounting, finance, HR, capital, and more.

jobs.description:
**About Origami Robotics**

Join a small team building the platform that turns physical robot experience into better behavior. You’ll own a focused infrastructure project used by robotics and ML engineers, work on real systems, and ship something that lasts beyond the internship.

**About the Role**

As a Robot Operator, you'll work directly with our robotic platforms to produce the training data our models depend on.

You'll use guided control interfaces to move robots through defined task sequences. Each demonstration you record becomes training signal, so how cleanly you execute translates directly into model quality.You'll run repeatable workflows, hold a consistent quality bar across long sessions, and help us make the collection process more reliable over time.

**In This Role, You'll**

**Operate Robots & Collect Data**

* Run robotic systems through guided control interfaces
* Execute defined task sequences built for model training
* Perform repetitive manipulation work without drift in precision
* Hold a consistent quality standard across every demonstration
* Hit daily volume and data-quality targets

**Monitor Quality**

* Watch for irregular system behavior and escalate it early
* Review recorded sessions and catch problems before they reach the dataset
* Give engineering clear, specific feedback on what you observed
* Suggest workflow changes that improve throughput or reliability

**Set Up & Maintain Equipment**

* Help with workstation setup and calibration
* Handle basic mechanical adjustments and first-pass troubleshooting
* Keep work areas organized and safe
* Confirm systems are ready before each shift starts

This role involves extended standing, full use of both arms and hands, strong hand–eye coordination, and sustained attention to fine detail.

We're Looking For Candidates Who

* Have hands-on experience in a lab, shop, manufacturing, or technical environment
* Are comfortable working around physical systems and moving equipment
* Can repeat a task hundreds of times without losing precision
* Do well in structured, output-driven settings
* Own their own quality bar rather than waiting to be checked
* Speak up early when something looks wrong

**Nice to have**

* Prior work with robotic systems or human-in-the-loop interfaces
* Background in assembly, machining, lab work, or skilled trades
* Comfort with controllers, VR interfaces, or simulation tools

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

jobs.description:
**About the Role**

**Location:** HQ - Williamsburg, Brooklyn

**Status:** Full-time/100% on-site

**Compensation:** $65,000-$75,000 annually

  

**Position Summary:**

Kith is seeking an IT Project & Operations Coordinator to support the execution of technology initiatives across our

retail, corporate, and e-commerce operations. This role sits at the intersection of project coordination and day-to-

day IT operations, with a strong emphasis on supporting new store openings and construction build-outs -

coordinating technology deployment timelines, vendors, and on-site readiness alongside the IT team. The ideal

candidate is organized, proactive, detail oriented, and comfortable working across construction schedules, vendor

relationships, and ticketing/operations systems in a fast-paced retail environment.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Store Construction & Rollout Coordination**

* Serve as the primary IT point of contact for new store openings and remodels, coordinating technology scope, timelines, and readiness from construction kickoff through opening.
* Partner with construction project managers, general contractors, and low-voltage/cabling vendors to schedule and track IT-related build-out milestones.
* Coordinate procurement and shipping of store IT hardware to align with construction and opening timelines.
* Track multiple concurrent projects (e.g., new openings, remodels) in a shared project tracker, flagging schedule risks and escalating blockers to the Director of IT.
* Conduct or coordinate pre-opening technology walkthroughs and punch-list resolution on-site or remotely.
Create/maintain documentation of store IT infrastructure standards, site-specific configurations, and lessons learned across openings.  

  

**IT Operations Support**

* Coordinate vendor relationships and purchase orders for hardware, networking, and telecom, in support of both retail and corporate needs.
* Assist with asset lifecycle tracking - procurement, deployment, inventory, and retirement of IT equipment.
Help maintain internal documentation, knowledge base articles, and the roles & responsibilities resource hub.  

  

**Project & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Build and maintain project plans, status reports, and timelines for IT initiatives; run recurring status check-ins with stakeholders.
* Coordinate across IT, Construction, Facilities, Finance, and Operations departments to keep technology workstreams aligned with broader store and business goals and timelines.
Prepare status updates and summaries for IT leadership on active projects, risks, and dependencies.  

  

**Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of experience in project coordination, IT operations, or a similar role – IT, retail, and construction-adjacent experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating timelines across multiple projects with multiple stakeholders (vendors, contractors, internal teams).
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals strongly preferred, sufficient to coordinate with vendors and technicians - hands-on experience not required.
* Comfortable using ITSM/ticketing platforms, project trackers, and standard productivity tools (Google Workspace preferred).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical timelines for non-technical stakeholders.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple concurrent projects with competing deadlines.
* Excellent follow through skills and “stay-on-top” of things attitude.
Willingness to travel periodically to store locations for on-site coordination and openings.  

  

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project coordination training/certification.  

  

**WHO WE ARE**

Established in 2011 in New York City, Kith is a lifestyle brand and specialty retailer that offers seasonal collections of men’s, women’s and children’s apparel, accessories and footwear through a distinct lens of personal storytelling. Kith embodies a multi-faceted lifestyle, with uncompromising detail to fabrication and design. Led by Founder, CEO and Creative Director Ronnie Fieg, the brand is known globally for evoking nostalgia from a dynamic point of view, and working closely with a carefully selected set of best-in-class collaborators.

  

Kith operates 16 standalone boutiques around the world, and 3 shop-in-shops. Kith Treats, conceived from Fieg’s childhood love for cereal, operates in 10 locations, as well as Sadelle’s at Kith restaurants in Paris, Miami Design District, Toronto and Seoul.

  

The Kinnect Foundation, a non-profit established and operated by Kith, is a non-profit devoted to creating positive change through education, community and social impact.

jobs.description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.

For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.
